arguments.InputPath: Required path to a player-supplied ISO/XISO disc image or fully extracted game folder.
arguments.Workspace: Per-user LocalAppData root for the pinned source checkouts and build status.
arguments.GameDirectory: Per-user game install directory. Existing settings and save data are retained.
arguments.Jobs: Optional positive parallel build-job limit; defaults to the processor count clamped to 1..8.
arguments.StatusPath: Optional JSON status path; defaults to <Workspace>/build-status.json.

status.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, atomically replaced after each state change

fields.progress: Integer 0..100, or null while the current operation has no measurable fraction
fields.outputExe: Absolute path to installed FuzionFrenzy.exe, or null

sdk.patchLifecycle: Apply for configure/compile; restore known patched files afterwards; recover exact known interrupted patches before checkout validation.

xbe.path: default.xbe at image root or extracted-folder root

build.configuration: Pinned committed game.toml; no symbol discovery or private input upload
